fact: Egypt's National Elections Authority announced it had officially completed updating the voter database.
The National Elections Authority says voters can check their electoral status through its new mobile app (Google Play, App Store) or its website by entering the 14-digit national number.
system: National Elections Authority app and website lookup

fact: The National Elections Authority says the update included reviewing voter entries and linking them to the national number to prevent duplicates or errors.
Law 198/2017 tasks the National Election Authority with preparing the voter database based on national identification number data and keeping it updated and cleaned.
